verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's own core repo documents an Emscripten/WASM build that runs in a browser with SharedMemory support, and hands-on users loaded it in Chrome on Mac, where menus and text input worked. That supports a browser-based, nothing-installed path. However, the users report a ~300MB download, sluggish performance, caching that forces re-download and recompile on reload, missing spell-check dictionaries, and failure in Safari on iPadOS/macOS. Nothing in the pack shows a document conversion actually being done in the browser build, and the documented conversion path (--convert-to) is the installed CLI. Missing for 10: evidence of an actual in-browser document conversion, an official hosted or turnkey browser offering, acceptable load time and caching for quick one-off use, cross-browser reliability.
